implemented: Remove the 160-record and 20000-character post-completion audit eviction. Preserve every source entry, sending id/source/text while retaining bbox/step locally.
Remove the 20000-character history eviction; retain observed text, regions, context and existing omission flags.
Default public exploration to maxActions=0 (unlimited). Explicit positive limits still judge the final observation. Rate, loop, origin and form protections remain.
Treat direct content choices as candidates without an uncalibrated 0.75 override. Individual applicability, sufficiency and contradiction checks still gate completion.

Clarify that one quote may apply to one requested party in a compound goal. Subsequent review narrowed this to parties corresponding to the quote's requestedInformation; another item's facility or scheme cannot substitute.
Strict action input uses a lossless observation pool referenced by ordered action history; combined legacy mode and original stored State remain unchanged.
Deduplicate exact accepted semantic quotes only in model input; retain report occurrences and distinct block provenance.

Batch contradiction checks by complete observed pages, preserving legends with rows. Aggregate only after every batch completes, with absent/uncertain vetoes. Report completed/total batches and no acquired label during incomplete contradiction checks.
Recognize strictly certified empty scaleX(0) or scaleY(0) pseudo decorations as non-painting. Preserve fail-closed handling of nonzero, combined, animated and uncertain paint.

Move the existing per-action interval from before execution to after execution and before the next observation. Initial navigation delay and safety checks remain; no extra delay or extra observation is added.

headerObservationDiagnosis.cause: HTML text is present. An empty ::after underline on inline anchors has transform matrix(0,0,0,1,0,0); existing paint certification treats this invisible zero-width decoration as unknown and excludes the entire label.
headerObservationDiagnosis.implementedFix: Recognize only narrowly certified empty zero-axis 2D pseudo decorations as non-painting; preserve existing fail-closed handling for nonzero/unknown effects.
headerObservationDiagnosis.postFixResult: All six previously excluded labels are observed and offered as action candidates. COMPLEX_PAINT_SKIPPED is absent. The unrelated unlabeled-control warning remains.
headerObservationDiagnosis.review: The initial fixture lacked UTF-8 content type. Corrected it, temporarily removed only the production branch to reconfirm two failing positive tests, then restored the fix and reran all focused tests. Independent review found no covered-text disclosure path in the scoped branch.
